The '''AC-10 Disruptor''' was a model of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] that was in use during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Bundle" />
{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The AC-10 Disruptor was a player mount in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It was added to the game in Game Update 7.6.1 and was offered to players who watched four hours of ''The Old Republic'' content on Twitch.<ref name="update">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250226|text=Game Update 7.6.1 Recap}}</ref>
